name: garden
description: Four skills: mini-tz (interview for one task producing a yes/no criteria file), review-loop (a different-family model checks the work against the criteria, or against the original request when there are none), profile (40-item IPIP-NEO questionnaire in Russian with a method-fit report and optional read-only audit), and play (a 10-minute interview to find what play is for you and how much of it your week holds).
